newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market quiet, no sale - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market quiet, no sale - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers with bids at $66.00 per cwt.
Last established market was Friday at 68.00 and sellers are pricing cattle steady or higher and waiting. Offerings expected to show an increase over last week's numbers.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
